To go from the EF to a corpo stablecoin chain is just sad. Tempo just another centralized corpo stablecoin altL1 that cosplaying decentralization with lots of VC backing and KoLs shilling. I really don't like the rationalization Tempo somehow shares Ethereum's value. My theory is Tempo has a TGE coming up and needed to buy some legitimacy to pump their token price by purchasing a token EF big name researcher to trot around like a show pony and post what they tell him to on his CT. That will be Dankrad's primary contribution to Tempo. My Geth + Lodestar node just finished filling my 2TB drive. Does Geth have any options that will make it take less space these days? <insert rant about Ethereum needing to care more about nodes being operable by end-users> Switch to Ethrex EL. Only takes 460GB fully synced https://ethrex.xyz/ Having said that, enable history expiry in Geth and then prune or resync you can wipe history, I'm far below 2TB today with geth + Prysm, doubt Lodestar's dbase is larger than Prysm's I'm using 1.2T today `--state.scheme=path` and `--prune-history` are what you want this will prune the pre-merge history (not sure if they already shipped rolling history pruning or not) 1.3TB for Geth, wiping history dropped that just below 1TB. A 2 "TB" drive is ~1.7TB in actual usable disk, so 1.3TB for Geth plus 400GB for Lodestar is sufficient to push one over the edge. I'm guessing I'll be right back in this situation again in some number of months, but this time without the easy ability of deleting pre-merge data. I used to run Nethermind, but blew out 2TB quicker and it was becoming too much trouble to constantly manage it to keep it under 2TB so I gave up. 😢 This is weird, I've got 677GB for geth ancient and 343 for the hot db still have 604GB free on my 2TB disk 643G for ancient and 381G for hot (according to `du -h`) after deleting pre-merge history. when the time comes that 2TB is untennable, I'll move ancient to a NAS with hdd ok that's more in line with what I have so probably Lodestar is not pruning, restart with checkpoint sync wiping the CL and that will give you peace of mind for a few months Having my node blow out its disk and needing to manually fix it every few months is why I eventually stopped running Nethermind. If I end up having to do that with Geth too I'll probably just stop running Ethereum nodes and join the masses in using one of 3 centralized service providers. Stop being do dramatic! First, a resync will give you more data back than a prune. Second, try Ethrex, only 460gb fully synced and only takes 2 hours to sync. Third, 4tb is pretty cheap nowadays. Or buy a 2nd 2tb and run in raid 0 Fourth, plug in a USB or hdd or nas on the lan and move ancient data to there Hello! There is an option to automatically prune nethermind's state when there is not a lot of space. it also constantly prunes history now, so should be better than before. More info: - pruning https://docs.nethermind.io/fundamentals/pruning/#storage-left-threshold - history expiration https://docs.nethermind.io/fundamentals/history-expiry I had pruning enabled but it still was running out of space. I don't think I had automatic history expiry (wasn't an option at the time) but I didn't download history so my history only went back to last sync. Let us validate this feature, could you share the pruning settings if possible? (moved conversation to Nethermind Discord server to not bother people here)
